verdict.rationale: File converters can plausibly offer an API with an interactive reference, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no API reference of any kind: every OpenAPI/Swagger probe path returned 404. Filee documents only a CLI (`filee convert`, `--json` output, exit codes), which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
